name: sdlc-workflow
description: Spec-driven agentic SDLC workflow: design phase (/spec-design, /spec, /grill-with-docs, /decompose), build phase (/build orchestrates Sonnet build subagents, Opus review, and a collector branch; /verify-context, /distill-context, /sync-docs), plus /setup-project, /audit-design, /update-skills (refresh installed skills, find stale copies), /feature-status (feature x surface build status), and shared utilities (/review-fix-loop, /worktree-hygiene, /env-handoff, /delegated-work-audit, /linear-implementation-audit). Canonical source and docs: github.com/mschabow/agentic-sdlc.
